candidates.statement: Inventory is running version 3.1.1 with configuration revision cfg-017 marked configuration_valid=false; inventory logs show configuration_value_rejected errors (status 503) and inventory metrics show 14 configuration_rejections with error_rate 0.1, matching the gateway trace of an ERROR call to inventory. This bounded bad-configuration fault explains the degraded checkout path.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not prove causation; the invalid config is inferred as the trigger from correlated rejection logs and metrics.

report.explanation: Inventory shows an invalid configuration revision (cfg-017) with configuration_value_rejected errors and elevated error_rate, and the gateway trace shows an ERROR call to inventory, supporting a bounded bad-configuration root cause. Order and payment metrics are healthy; no memory-retention or pool-exhaustion evidence exists.
